elements.label: Figure A24
elements.title: Calculate the Average Height Using AVERAGE in MS Excel (Used with permission from Microsoft)
elements.details: Screenshot of an Excel worksheet showing MLB players data with columns: Name, Team, Position, Height(inches), Weight(pounds), Age. The Height column cells D2 to D13 are highlighted, and the formula =AVERAGE(D2:D13) is entered in cell D14. Heights range from 70 to 82 inches.
elements.summary: This screenshot demonstrates how to calculate the average height of MLB players using the AVERAGE formula in Excel.

elements.label: Table A1
elements.title: Example MS Excel Formulas
elements.details:
| Formula       | Description                                                                                 |
|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| =MEDIAN(D2:D13) | Compute median of D2, D3, ..., and D13. Returns 72.5 as a result.                            |
| =STDEV(D2:D13)  | Compute standard deviation of D2, D3, ..., and D13. Returns 3.28 as a result.               |
elements.summary: This table lists example Excel formulas for summarizing data, including median and standard deviation calculations with their descriptions and results.
